newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka gains at close on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka recovered early losses on Monday, making heavy gains to finish at 42.5200/5300 to the dollar in interbank trading after banks offered a large volume of U.S. currency to the market, dealers said.
That was up from the previous close of 42.5300/5360.
The local unit was quoted weaker at 42.5325/5425 per dollar in early trade on higher dollar demand following two dull sessions.
The call money rose sharply and traded at 6.0 percent to 7.5 percent against a previous 4.75-5.25 percent.
